title: deployment_assembly_inventory (BR-RUA-042)
description: The canonical inventory of the frozen deployment assembly copied into the evidence package (design §9.8 S3). Each entry is one regular file: its normalized path relative to assembly_path, byte count, permission bits as four octal digits, and SHA-256. Symlinks, special files and container-image assets are rejected before an inventory exists, so the inventory has no field to describe them. Entries are sorted by path in strictly ascending code-point order, so each path appears once, and inventory_sha256 is the digest of the canonical JSON of the entry list; path uniqueness, that order and that digest are checked in code by the assembly inventory builder and the evidence-package verifier, not by this schema, which rejects only byte-identical duplicate entries.
